full_capture_requirements.read_only_observer: No configuration,process movement,gate release,launch,kill,reap,install,fetch,subject writes,secret inspection or authority. Provider actions require a separate reviewed implementation/scope.
full_capture_requirements.memory_only_output: Evidence transport/persistence is external and not implemented. No background collector/thread/timer/singleton.
full_capture_requirements.source_truth: Only real producer boundary events can later establish observed values. This design and the pure validator verify supplied metadata only.
full_capture_requirements.source_event: producer instance source_id plus sequence identifies the exact event consumed;event_id and content_digest bind immutable source-packet content,not authenticity.
full_capture_requirements.atomicity: A coherent packet with capture window is not physically atomic across kernel reads. NOT_ESTABLISHED always.
full_capture_requirements.identity: No branch/wall-clock/objectaddress/ActionsID-derived H identity. Provider must separately establish actual owned identities/generations.
full_capture_requirements.cohorts: Every original O/D source pin needs a consumption witness for each of its three registered commands. No registry constant substitution.
full_capture_requirements.limits: APPROVED_LIMIT+APPLIED_LIMIT+ENFORCEMENT_WITNESS per target limit. No H numeric values/latency/overshoot thresholds invented.
full_capture_requirements.controls: CONTROL_OBSERVATION+CONTEXT_BINDING per control;payload includes specific effect/review evidence from catalog,not a success boolean alone.
full_capture_requirements.status_streams: Actual producer stream outcome required. Missing/lost stream cannot become successful empty errors/unavailable.
full_capture_requirements.wire_v1: Do not reinterpret existing DTO facets or coarse producer codes. Evidence sidecar is separate;any future H target adapter requires separate review/versioning.

future_pure_interface.digest: str exactly64lowerhex or None;run_id exactly32lowerhex or None
future_pure_interface.clock_domain: None or exact ASCII1..128 characters A-Z/a-z/0-9/._:-;opaque declared monotonic source domain,not a wall timestamp
future_pure_interface.command_id: None or exact one of O-PYTEST/O-H6/O-H7/D-PYTEST/D-H6/D-COVERAGE;None is expected for batch-scoped witness,missing for command-scoped witness
future_pure_interface.role_and_stage: closed per target+role mapping from capture-catalog.json. Unknown target/role/stage combinations raise constant ValueError before effects.
future_pure_interface.sequences: Exact tuple. Duplicate target_path+role is malformed even if identical;missing keys assess unavailable;sort by catalog target order then role order. Constructor owns copied nested tuples.
future_pure_interface.structural_errors: constant ValueError without quoting inputs or input-bearing parser exception context. No coerce/default/fallback;foreign/subclass/forged malformed graph rejected.
future_pure_interface.fixed_null_not_available: Prepared evidence can be supplied before an H epoch,with explicit None. The validator returns unavailable and never fills it from source constants/current clocks.

assessment_algorithm: Revalidate complete exact graph;structural malformed raises ValueError. Initialize separate errors/unavailable;never early-return on missing epoch or witness.
Bundle epoch None or each nullable scalar adds EPOCH_UNAVAILABLE at exact root field. Missing capture_begin/end adds CAPTURE_WINDOW_UNAVAILABLE;known end<begin adds TIME_ORDER_INVALID.
For each of273 catalog target+role slots:missing witness adds WITNESS_MISSING(field witnesses). No default entry is manufactured. Check every supplied known witness regardless of missing others.
NEGATIVE_CLAIM adds NEGATIVE_CLAIM at outcome;ERROR_CLAIM adds PRODUCER_REPORTED_ERROR;UNAVAILABLE_CLAIM adds WITNESS_UNAVAILABLE. PRESENT_CLAIM never means observed or trusted.

Missing witness context/epoch/epochfields adds CONTEXT_UNAVAILABLE at exact field. Compare each available epoch run_id/policy_digest/clock_domain against ALL other available values for that primitive across bundle and witnesses,not only against bundle root. If different known values exist,mark every known participating witness with EPOCH_MISMATCH(run/policy) or CLOCK_DOMAIN_MISMATCH(domain) at its exact context.epoch field;also mark the corresponding root field when it is known. Missing root/context never hides proven peer contradictions. Unknown on either side remains unavailable and is never filled.

Catalog scope determines command_id:batch expects None and attempt None;known command/attempt at batch witness ->COMMAND_MISMATCH. Command-scoped requires exact expected registered command_id and nonnull attempt;missing ->CONTEXT_UNAVAILABLE;known wrong command ->COMMAND_MISMATCH. No implicit reassignment.

Every supplied context requires boundary_digest and boundary_generation;missing adds CONTEXT_UNAVAILABLE. Group contexts by expected batch/command scope. Available unequal attempt,boundary digest or generation inside a group ->CONTEXT_CHANGED at each conflicting supplied member;None never hides other known conflicts. Distinct group boundary_digest reuse ->BOUNDARY_REUSE at all involved supplied members;generation0 valid.
source_id,event_id,sequence,event_time_ns missing adds EVENT_IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE per field;content_digest missing adds CONTENT_REFERENCE_UNAVAILABLE. No reader is invoked to fill any field.

Group logical event claims by either complete known(source_id,sequence) OR known event_id. Within each group compare known primitive metadata leaves recursively:source_id,event_id,sequence,event_time_ns,stage,context fields,content_digest. A missing field adds its existing unavailable reason,not an alias by itself,but NEVER suppresses another known conflict. Different known source_id or different known sequence at one event_id is enough for SOURCE_EVENT_ALIAS even when another identity component is None. Known time/stage/context/content conflicts at one event_id also reject with partial source identity. Mark all known participating entries. Exact same event metadata may legitimately serve different target+role keys;duplicate target+role was already structurally rejected.

Cross-context time comparisons require BOTH explicit clock domains known and equal. For event-v-window use witness.context.epoch.clock_domain and bundle.epoch.clock_domain;for per-source sequence/time or per-command stage pairs use both witness domains. Unknown domain keeps its EPOCH/CONTEXT_UNAVAILABLE reason and skips the numeric comparison;different known domains retain CLOCK_DOMAIN_MISMATCH and skip incomparable numeric window/time/stage comparisons. Root begin/end describe one asserted window,so known end<begin remains TIME_ORDER_INVALID even if that window's domain name is unavailable. Never infer/correct clock domains.

With that same-known-domain prerequisite,within each source_id known greater sequence with lower known event_time ->TIME_ORDER_INVALID at later event;different sources' sequences are independent. Each known event_time must lie within available begin/end bounds inclusive;otherwise EVENT_OUTSIDE_CAPTURE_WINDOW. Known source-event alias comparisons still compare claimed metadata identity even if clock domains conflict;they do not measure elapsed time.

With that same-known-domain prerequisite,within each command scope known stage timestamps must preserve BOUNDARY_READY<=LIMITS_APPLIED<=PRE_RELEASE<=COMMAND_START<=COMMAND_FINISH<=BATCH_FINISH when both compared stages are present. All comparable times in an earlier class must be<=all comparable times in a later class. PREPARED_BINDING,CONTROL_WITNESS,PRODUCER_STATUS have no extra phase ordering. Missing stages are not fabricated. Actual target start/deadline/budget payload math is NOT checked because payload values are absent from this metadata-only slice.

Sort/deduplicate issues by(code,target_path,role,field). Decision construction rejects wrong issue category or locator. Errors ->REJECTED;else unavailable ->UNAVAILABLE;else COHORT_METADATA_CONSISTENT. All outcomes still BLOCKED/provenance metadata only/all9false/no target record.
